data.text: Simulation results reveal that the landscape of Thimphu city has changed considerably during the study period and the change trend is predicted to continue into 2050.

active voice, subject-verb-object structure
temporal prepositional phrase

data.text: The study observed a significant increase (12.77%) in built-up area from 2002 (52.88%) to 2018 (65.5%), followed by a slight increase in the cover of bare ground.

meta.grammar_justification: "cover of ground" is the object that is being increased, so it is a part of the "built-up area"
"followed by" indicates a sequence of events, so the increase in bare ground comes after the increase in built-up area
"an increase of 12.77%" indicates that the measurement is associated with the change in the built-up area.

data.text: On the contrary, forest cover declined drastically (15.25%) followed by agriculture (1.01%).
Rapid population growth triggered by rural urban migration coupled with hasty socio-economic development post democracy are the main drivers of these changes.

meta.grammar_justification: subject-verb-object structure, "these changes are the result of"
subject-verb-object structure, "growth triggered by" is a causal phrase
adjective-noun relationship, "rapid population growth" describes "growth"

"hasty socio-economic development post democracy is a factor in" "growth", implicit causal relationship from context
"rural urban migration is associated with" "urban"
"hasty socio-economic development post democracy is associated with" "urban"

data.text: Under the business as usual scenario, prediction analysis for the year 2050 show that built up area will consume almost all of the city area (73.21%) with forest significantly reduced to patches making up only about 16% of the city.

data.text: Prior to this, the area was occupied by terraced agricultural fields and some 13 villages.
